name: starfab assembly hall
unofficialDisclaimer: Unofficial fan or learning project, not affiliated with SpaceX.

hall.label: Assembly hall
hall.blurb: A fictional assembly hall: a board sub-line and a housing sub-line meet at one join station, then test and pack-out.

demandInfo.statement: an invented figure with no public source behind it

annualDemandKits.note: 2,000,000 units a year. Invented, with no public source.

calendarDays.note: Demand is spread evenly over 365 days.

hoursPerDay.note: Coverage is modeled as 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

meanDowntimeEventSeconds.note: Mean downtime event of 900 seconds, exact budget per machine.

bufferCapacity.note: Room for 3 parts after each station.

joinRule.note: S3 needs one board and one housing to start a unit. Two parts become one unit.

downtimeReasons.note: Reasons cycle at 4, 3, 2, 1 per 10 events. Not plant data.

endOfShiftWip.note: Parts and units still on the floor at the end of the shift are WIP.

starts.note: S1 and S2 each start a part whenever a machine is free.

name.note: Five generic stations. Two sub-lines meet at S3. Not a real layout.

parallelUnits.note: Machines per station per line. Real counts are unknown.

operators.note: One operator per station. Real staffing is unknown.

firstPassYield.note: Yield 0.98 at each station, no rework.

performance.note: Pace of 0.95 versus the engineered cycle.
